failure_policy: Stop queue on failed run, nonfinite recorded loss, configuration mismatch or incomplete evaluation grid. Preserve every attempt. No automatic production restart/resume and no outcome-based exclusions.
power_failure_policy: No reboot autostart. Audit partial runs before explicit restart authorization.
historical_provenance_limit: HER/SABER/Random original full configs were not retained; use earliest retained canonical source and original launchers. PER uses retained frozen preset. Original-config parity is tested where configs survive. Historical bitwise environment identity is not asserted.
statistics_note: Primary metric definitions are unchanged. Extension and pooled comparisons use paired 10000-resample percentile bootstrap. Historical exact 3125-assignment mechanism intervals remain separately reported; they are not overwritten or claimed identical to Monte Carlo intervals. No selective stopping for significance.
